messages.content: This is a placeholder snapshot of #announce > Zulip updates. Once ZULIP_ANNOUNCE_EMAIL and ZULIP_ANNOUNCE_API_KEY are set on the github-pages environment, CI will replace this file with the latest ~30 messages from chat.zulip.org at deploy time.

The snapshot transport is read-only: the demo fetches a baked JSON file instead of opening a live event queue, so no API credentials ever travel to the browser.

See scripts/fetch-announce-snapshot.mjs for the CI script and src/snapshot-transport.ts for the runtime.
